No production code edited this turn. Read-only investigation: fetched live XianGuanJia llms.txt + ship/edit-product/kam-list endpoint docs, and Read RentalDeviceDO/RentalDeviceAssignmentDO/RentalDeviceOpsService/RentalDeviceInboundService/RentalDeviceAdminService/XianyuRentalConversionServiceImpl + frontend device & xianyu views. Conclusion: XianGuanJia open API exposes NO write endpoint for order remark/seller_remark/device SN (ship endpoint has no remark field; edit-product only has product-level outer_id and yx_3c.model_sn). Plan-1 (device-instance <-> Xianyu-order mapping in local backend) is structurally complete: rental_device.serial_number + rental_device_assignment(rentalOrderItemId<->deviceId) already link SN to channel order. Gap found: RentalDeviceInboundService.generateFromPurchaseIn builds devices WITHOUT serialNumber, and ErpPurchaseInItemDO has no SN field, so SN source is missing. Proposed follow-up (not yet implemented): add POST /admin-api/rental/device/{id}/serial capture endpoint + use signed QR (RentalDeviceQrCodec) as primary instance identity. Also noted returnDevice note field is no-op (no assignment note column in V1). Awaiting user decision on SN-capture path and whether to add assignment.note column before any production edit.

Read-only live probe of XianGuanJia open API using local .env.xianyu credentials (no production code edited). Endpoints called (all read-only, self-developed MD5 signing per docs/integrations/xianyu/authentication.md): /api/open/user/authorize/list -> 6 authorized shops; /api/open/order/list -> scanned 8000 orders (180-day update_time window, 80 pages x100) for seller_remark matching SN pattern (序列号|机身号|机身|SN|IMEI|串号|机器号); /api/open/order/detail on the single match. Result: exactly 1 order (order_no 3313011255890094097, status 21, pay_amount 27000) contains seller_remark '发货7.22收货7.23发回7.28\n设备型号300U+400镜头\n设备序列号300U-09-2001TK'. Confirms (a) XianGuanJia API exposes NO structured device-SN field (order/list and order/detail have no SN/IMEI column, goods.outer_id empty, goods.sku_text is rent-type not SN); (b) SellerRemarkRentalPeriodParser does NOT recognize the SN line nor parse this remark's 连写 dates, so such orders fall to manual review and the SN is dropped. Candidate follow-up (not implemented): SellerRemarkSerialNumberExtractor writing a nullable xianyu_order.extracted_serial_number column, best-effort match to rental_device at assignment time. Secrets handled via local env file read, never printed; phone masked to last-4.
